info.title: fushi.moe public API
info.description: Read-only, unauthenticated JSON endpoints behind the Fushi website: the latest release manifest with per-platform download links, download statistics and the GitHub star count. All responses are edge-cached and send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

externalDocs.description: How to use these endpoints (agent skill)

get.summary: Latest Fushi release: version, tag and a download link per platform slot

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Release channel. Omit for the stable channel, which is what end users should install.

503.description: Manifest temporarily unavailable; fall back to https://github.com/hajisensai/Fushi/releases/latest

get.summary: Download the latest stable installer for one platform slot
get.description: Serves the file from the site's mirror, or redirects to the same asset on GitHub Releases. Supports Range requests.

302.description: Redirect to the asset on GitHub Releases

404.description: Unknown slot, or this release has no asset for it

get.summary: Download counts (site mirror + GitHub release assets)
GitHub star count of the Fushi repository

Slot.description: Platform slot. windows is the installer, windows-portable the no-install zip; macos is Apple Silicon only; android-universal exists on the debug channel only; bridge-* are the companion Bridge APKs.

url.description: Same-domain download link (mirror with GitHub fallback). Prefer this one.

githubUrl.description: The same asset on GitHub Releases

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file, when known

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 publish time; may be empty

slots.description: Slot name → asset. A slot is null when this release has no asset for it.

total.description: Headline number: GitHub release asset downloads plus downloads served from the site mirror. null when the GitHub half has never been fetched.

site.description: Downloads counted by the site itself, broken down by channel, slot, source, tag and day

github.description: Sum of download_count over GitHub release assets, by tag and slot

stale.description: true when the GitHub half is a cached older copy
